keyPoints: Varg sankhya kisi sankhya ko khud se guna karne par milti hai — 12^2 = 144; varg sankhya ka antim ank 0, 1, 4, 5, 6, 9 me se hi hota hai.
1 se lekar n tak ki visham sankhyaon ka yog n^2 hota hai — 1+3+5+7 = 16 = 4^2.
Do lagatar prakritik sankhyaon m, m+1 ke liye (m+1)^2 - m^2 = 2m + 1 hota hai.
Vargmul (square root) varg ka ulta hai — √144 = 12; √ ko karni (radical) chihn kehte hain.
Abhajya gunankhand se vargmul: jode banao, har jode se ek lo — √576 = √(2^2 x 2^2 x 2^2 x 3^2) = 2 x 2 x 2 x 3 = 24.
Bhaag-vidhi (division method) se badi sankhyaon ka vargmul nikaalte hain — jode me baant kar step-by-step.
Aam galti: √(a+b) ko √a + √b samajhna — vargmul jod par nahi bat-ta, √(9+16) = 5 hai, 3+4 = 7 nahi.

title: Varg aur Vargmul
